fusions.name: Passed Down the Table
fusions.desc: A sweep of air that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Your afflictions on each target are carried to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Clean Plate
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A bite that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Kitchen Smells Carry
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dinner Settles
fusions.desc: When you are healed, it also restores 9 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
